prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: base color texture for the EXISTING curved flower petal geometry in an interactive Three.js island. Natural and refined, visible at close range without heavy contrast. Constraints: no text, no border, no watermark, no background scene, no object photography, no 3D render of a flower. Opaque square texture.
